title: PDF LAB Workbench Batch A: encounter and inspection of the two poems
statement: Implements WORKBENCH-BUILD.md phases 0-2 as a TanStack Start app in sideprojects/pdf-lab/workbench: read-only hashed ingestion, runtime-validated adapters over recorded MuPDF/Poppler runs and fixture bytes, and a specimen page with reveal, line inspector, extracted-text and comparison views and original download.
